mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are enjoying clear skies at Verona City Hall, and since it is not after 5 PM, we do not have an overnight forecast to report.

City news includes a police investigation regarding a school bus driver arrested this past Thursday for impaired driving. Also, the city reminds residents that updated zoning maps and polling locations are available on the city website to help you prepare for upcoming elections.

There is plenty to do in our area, including the Dane County Farmers Market today. You can also catch live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company throughout today. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga on October 19 and trivia nights starting October 20 at various local spots.

On Thursday, October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for operating a vehicle while impaired. Officers stopped the bus after reports of dangerous driving, but thankfully, no injuries occurred.
Stop by Culver's today to enjoy the delicious Chocolate Volcano flavor of the day. The restaurant is currently open and will be serving customers until 10:30 PM tonight.
